component.name: AVD Feed + Connect Linux
component.summary: Connect to your Azure Virtual Desktop workspaces

description.p: AVD Feed + Connect is a native Linux client for Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Windows 365. Sign in with your work account and it lists the desktops and remote apps you are entitled to, just like the Microsoft Windows App on Windows and macOS — then launches them over RDP.

ul.li: In-app Microsoft Entra ID sign-in (interactive, so Conditional Access is honored)
Automatic workspace/resource discovery from the AVD feed
Workspace grid with the real per-resource icons
Camera and microphone redirection, and multi-monitor support
Bundles a hardened FreeRDP that survives audio-device changes mid-call

description.p: This is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
Fix a doubled/stacked desktop on some setups: connections default to a single fullscreen monitor again. Enable multi-monitor with AVD_EXTRA_ARGS="/multimon".

Connections now run over X11/XWayland to fix an immediate crash on native Wayland. Remote scaling follows the display (HiDPI 200% / standard 100%) instead of a fixed 200%; set AVD_SCALE or AVD_EXTRA_ARGS (e.g. "/multimon") to customize.
Rebuilt the UI on GTK4 with the modern WebKitGTK 6.0 engine. Fixes the embedded sign-in page freezing for organizations that use federated identity providers (ADFS, Okta, Ping, etc.).
Now builds FreeRDP from upstream master — the PulseAudio hot-unplug fixes that prevent mid-call freezes were merged upstream, so the fork is no longer needed.
Packaging: the downloadable bundle now self-updates via flatpak update (embeds the update URL + signing key).
Persistent session: reopening shows your workspaces immediately and refreshes the token in the background, like the Windows App. Sign-in is only required on first run or after an explicit sign out.
First release: feed discovery, in-app sign-in, workspace grid, and connect via a bundled hardened FreeRDP (camera/mic redirection).
